# Saved view request examples

Source: request examples published by the SigNoz OpenAPI document at 09bba8960dfc3e0a43dc54d6d7cf203aae9841f4.

## Create a view (POST /api/v2/saved_views)

### 1. logs_list_generated_name — Logs list view with a generated name

A list panel over error logs of one service. generateName lets the server derive the machine name from displayName; the display preferences set the row format and font size.

```json
{
  "generateName": true,
  "schemaVersion": "v2",
  "source": "logs",
  "spec": {
    "display": {
      "fontSize": "small",
      "format": "list",
      "maxLines": 2
    },
    "displayName": "Payment errors",
    "panelType": "list",
    "queries": [
      {
        "spec": {
          "filter": {
            "expression": "service.name = 'paymentservice' AND severity_text = 'ERROR'"
          },
          "limit": 100,
          "name": "A",
          "order": [
            {
              "direction": "desc",
              "key": {
                "name": "timestamp"
              }
            },
            {
              "direction": "desc",
              "key": {
                "name": "id"
              }
            }
          ],
          "signal": "logs"
        },
        "type": "builder_query"
      }
    ],
    "requestType": "raw",
    "selectedFields": [
      {
        "fieldContext": "resource",
        "fieldDataType": "string",
        "name": "service.name",
        "signal": "logs"
      },
      {
        "fieldContext": "log",
        "fieldDataType": "string",
        "name": "severity_text",
        "signal": "logs"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

### 2. meter_time_series — Cost meter graph view

A graph panel on the meter explorer. Meter views are queried as metrics with the builder spec source set to meter; the meter rolls up hourly, so the step is 3600 seconds.

```json
{
  "name": "log-ingestion-volume",
  "schemaVersion": "v2",
  "source": "meter",
  "spec": {
    "displayName": "Log ingestion volume",
    "panelType": "graph",
    "queries": [
      {
        "spec": {
          "aggregations": [
            {
              "metricName": "signoz.meter.log.size",
              "spaceAggregation": "sum",
              "timeAggregation": "increase"
            }
          ],
          "name": "A",
          "signal": "metrics",
          "source": "meter",
          "stepInterval": 3600
        },
        "type": "builder_query"
      }
    ],
    "requestType": "time_series",
    "selectedFields": []
  }
}
```

### 3. metrics_time_series — Metrics graph view

A graph panel plotting the per-second request rate of a counter, summed across series at one minute resolution.

```json
{
  "name": "http-request-rate",
  "schemaVersion": "v2",
  "source": "metrics",
  "spec": {
    "displayName": "HTTP request rate",
    "panelType": "graph",
    "queries": [
      {
        "spec": {
          "aggregations": [
            {
              "metricName": "http_requests_total",
              "spaceAggregation": "sum",
              "timeAggregation": "rate"
            }
          ],
          "groupBy": [
            {
              "fieldContext": "resource",
              "fieldDataType": "string",
              "name": "service.name"
            }
          ],
          "name": "A",
          "signal": "metrics",
          "stepInterval": 60
        },
        "type": "builder_query"
      }
    ],
    "requestType": "time_series",
    "selectedFields": []
  }
}
```

### 4. traces_list — Traces list view with filter and columns

A list panel over spans slower than 500ms in one service, ordered newest first, with three explorer columns.

```json
{
  "name": "slow-checkout-traces",
  "schemaVersion": "v2",
  "source": "traces",
  "spec": {
    "displayName": "Slow checkout traces",
    "panelType": "list",
    "queries": [
      {
        "spec": {
          "filter": {
            "expression": "service.name = 'checkoutservice' AND duration_nano > 500000000"
          },
          "limit": 100,
          "name": "A",
          "order": [
            {
              "direction": "desc",
              "key": {
                "name": "timestamp"
              }
            }
          ],
          "signal": "traces"
        },
        "type": "builder_query"
      }
    ],
    "requestType": "raw",
    "selectedFields": [
      {
        "fieldContext": "resource",
        "fieldDataType": "string",
        "name": "service.name",
        "signal": "traces"
      },
      {
        "fieldContext": "span",
        "fieldDataType": "string",
        "name": "name",
        "signal": "traces"
      },
      {
        "fieldContext": "span",
        "fieldDataType": "float64",
        "name": "duration_nano",
        "signal": "traces"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## Replace a view (PUT /api/v2/saved_views/{id})

### 1. traces_list_widen_filter — Replace a traces list view

Replaces the spec of an existing traces list view with a wider latency filter and one more column. Every field of spec must be sent again; the machine name stays as created.

```json
{
  "schemaVersion": "v2",
  "source": "traces",
  "spec": {
    "displayName": "Slow checkout traces (over 250ms)",
    "panelType": "list",
    "queries": [
      {
        "spec": {
          "filter": {
            "expression": "service.name = 'checkoutservice' AND duration_nano > 250000000"
          },
          "limit": 100,
          "name": "A",
          "order": [
            {
              "direction": "desc",
              "key": {
                "name": "timestamp"
              }
            }
          ],
          "signal": "traces"
        },
        "type": "builder_query"
      }
    ],
    "requestType": "raw",
    "selectedFields": [
      {
        "fieldContext": "resource",
        "fieldDataType": "string",
        "name": "service.name",
        "signal": "traces"
      },
      {
        "fieldContext": "span",
        "fieldDataType": "string",
        "name": "name",
        "signal": "traces"
      },
      {
        "fieldContext": "span",
        "fieldDataType": "float64",
        "name": "duration_nano",
        "signal": "traces"
      },
      {
        "fieldContext": "attribute",
        "fieldDataType": "string",
        "name": "http.status_code",
        "signal": "traces"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```
